Non-inferiority contrasts, registered before scoring

Source: R/core-bench-ni.R
hr_contrast.Rd

hr_contrast() states that arm new is not worse than arm reference by more than margin in accuracy and, with cost_test = TRUE, that it is cheaper. hr_register_contrasts() fixes a set of contrasts against an hr_reference() before any benchmark scores it, with the design MDD from hr_mdd(), and hr_report() tests them.

Usage

hr_contrast(new, reference, margin, confirmatory = TRUE, cost_test = TRUE)

hr_register_contrasts(plan, contrasts, mdd)

# S3 method for class 'hr_contrast'
print(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'hr_contrast_registration'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

new

The name of the arm under test.

reference

The name of the arm it is compared with.

margin

The non-inferiority margin Delta, as a proportion (0.08 for 8 points), in (0, 1). Pre-register it as min(0.5 x M1, the practical loss threshold), with M1 the reference's advantage over a minimal baseline from a pilot on the dev split.

confirmatory

TRUE for a confirmatory contrast, in the Holm family and held to the MDD; FALSE for an exploratory one.

cost_test

Whether the verdict also needs new to be cheaper than reference.

plan

The hr_reference() the benchmark will score, before it is scored.

contrasts

An hr_contrast or a list of them.

mdd

An hr_mdd() for the planned design.

x

An hr_contrast or hr_contrast_registration.

...

Ignored.

Value

hr_contrast() returns an object of class hr_contrast, a list of its arguments. hr_register_contrasts() returns an object of class hr_contrast_registration, a list with contrasts (a data frame with new, reference, margin, confirmatory, label, cost_test and mdd_design, the MDD each contrast is held to), mdd (the hr_mdd() after Holm over the confirmatory contrasts), mdd_single (the same design without the Holm adjustment), alpha, power, n_confirmatory, reference_hash, registered_at and hash.

Details

Registration. A confirmatory contrast whose margin is below the design MDD at 80% power after Holm over the confirmatory contrasts is refused with an error of class hr_margin_below_mdd: a non-inferiority claim at a margin finer than the design can detect says more than the items hold. Registering it with confirmatory = FALSE labels it exploratory instead; it is then tested at the unadjusted alpha and stays out of the Holm family. The MDD checked is mdd recomputed with n_contrasts raised to the number of confirmatory contrasts when it was lower, holm = TRUE, power raised to 0.8 when it was lower, and alpha lowered to 0.025 when it was higher; hr_report() tests at that alpha. The design may not hold more items or clusters than the reference has on the test and final splits (an error of class gr_bad_setting).

A reference that a benchmark has begun to score in this session, or one rebuilt with the same content, is refused, with an error of class hr_registration_after_scoring, since a margin chosen after the results are seen is not pre-registered. The registration records the reference's hash, the time and a SHA-256 hash of its own content; hr_report() refuses a registration whose content no longer matches its hash or that names another reference.

See also

hr_mdd(), hr_report(), hr_reference()

Other harness: gr_arm(), gr_qa_reference(), gr_scorer_answer(), hr_arm(), hr_benchmark(), hr_drift_check(), hr_mdd(), hr_reference(), hr_report(), hr_scorer()

Examples

ref <- hr_reference(paste0("q", 1:480), labels = rep("yes", 480),
                    cluster = rep(paste0("doc", 1:80), each = 6), split = "test")
design <- hr_mdd(480, n_clusters = 80, icc = 0.2, p_disc = 0.2)
design$mdd
#> [1] 0.08188689

# A 10-point margin can be registered; a 5-point one only as exploratory.
reg <- hr_register_contrasts(ref, list(
  hr_contrast("short", "long", margin = 0.10),
  hr_contrast("skim", "long", margin = 0.05, confirmatory = FALSE)), design)
reg
#> <hr_contrast_registration> 2 contrast(s), 1 confirmatory; registered 2026-11-12T23:25:45.087Z
#>  contrast      label        margin mdd cost_test
#>  short vs long confirmatory 10.0   8.2 yes      
#>  skim vs long  exploratory  5.0    8.2 yes      
#>   Margins and MDD in points; reference db69600f91ae; hash 94842c2bd58b
try(hr_register_contrasts(ref, hr_contrast("skim", "long", margin = 0.05), design))
#> Error in hr_register_contrasts(ref, hr_contrast("skim", "long", margin = 0.05),  : 
#>   The margin of skim vs long (5.0 points) is below the design MDD of 8.2 points (80% power, one-sided alpha 0.025 after Holm over 1 contrast(s)), so the design cannot support a non-inferiority claim at it. Widen the margin, enlarge the design, or register the contrast with confirmatory = FALSE as exploratory.
